data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, three times per day, you can channel disruptive energy through your weapon against an undead creature. You must declare your use of this ability before you roll your attack. If your attack hits an undead creature, you deal an extra %1d6 points of damage. If your attack misses or your target was not an undead creature, the use of the ability is wasted.|1+min(5,TL/4)
